children: ImmunityBio amended its revenue interest purchase agreement with its purchasers, represented by Infinity SA as agent. The amendment allows the company, subject to conditions and regulatory approvals, to require a further $65 million purchase of revenue interests, and gives purchasers an option through April 15, 2027, to receive up to $400 million of repayments in shares instead of cash. The changes also adjust revenue-sharing rates and repayment terms.
: Third amendment to Revenue Interest Purchase Agreement
: Purchasers, with Infinity SA as agent
: Equitization option exercisable through Apr 15 2027; RIPA obligations continue until repaid or otherwise terminated
: Provide financing flexibility and allow partial repayment in shares

title: ImmunityBio Adds $400 Million Stock Repayment Option and Contingent $65 Million Financing
